brief: The canvas displays an evocative, ephemeral scene of delicate, paper-cut ships sailing across a translucent sheet. Time has profoundly aged the vessels, warping the paper and leaving visible tears and blemishes. As the ships traverse the surface, they leave dissolving trails that precipitate dense formations of crystalline salt and mineral deposits. These mineral streaks harden into complex, brittle scaffolds, alongside small, detached fragments of the warped paper. These fragments continuously drift and accumulate into small piles along the edges of the sheet, creating a dynamic visual narrative of decay, slow movement, and deposition.

statement: This sketch presents a hauntingly beautiful scene of aged paper-cut ships navigating a translucent, deteriorating surface. The vessels, marked by natural decay and visible tears, leave behind trails that gradually transform into crystalline mineral formations. These deposits harden into brittle scaffolds while small fragments of the damaged paper drift and accumulate along the edges, creating a dynamic narrative of slow erosion and sedimentation. The viewer observes an eternal cycle where each ship's journey contributes to the evolving landscape, with decay and formation occurring simultaneously across the canvas.
